steps.label: S1
steps.title: Step 1: Mapping the BCTs from the BCTO to the TaTT
steps.input: the 281 class labels and definitions in BCTO (published in May, 2024)，及 September, 2025 更新版新增四个类后的现行 BCTO（L31–L32）

steps.label: S2
steps.title: Step 2: Mapping the MoAs from the MoA Ontology to the TaTT
steps.input: the 284 class labels and definitions in the MoA Ontology (published May, 2024)，及 September, 2025 更新后 622 类总量的现行 MoA Ontology（L34、L37）
